description: Register this Claude Code / Claude / ChatGPT session with BAMF so it shows in the user's bamf.ai Recent chats (with the client's logo) and can be continued there or resumed locally. Creates or updates one linked bamf.ai chat and returns its URL plus, for Claude Code, the documented resume command (claude --resume <id>). Safe to call repeatedly; it only bumps last activity. Send the same external_session_id each time.

channel.description: Client surface. Detected from the client when omitted.

cwd.description: Working directory, used in the resume command.

external_session_id.description: The client's own session id (Claude Code: the session UUID).

machine.description: Machine label, e.g. mini or pro.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace UUID; defaults to the key's pin, else the user's most recent chat workspace.

name: bamf.link_session
